name: Improve ability to source project providers
description: Make it dramatically easier for coordinators to find and onboard industry project providers at scale. This includes the Product Catalog, Project Brief Generator, and industry partner portal.

name: Improve customer expansion of Practera deployment
description: Reduce time-to-value for new institutions. Make the platform easier to deploy, configure, and white-label. Includes LMS/LTI improvements, multi-tenancy, and template library.

name: Deliver more value to mentors and project providers
description: Build richer tools for mentors and industry partners: project visibility, learner progress tracking, feedback workflows, and recognition.

name: Provide offerings direct to learners
description: Enable learners to discover and enrol in experiential programs without going through an institution. Includes consumer-facing discovery, direct payments, and individual program access.
